result.title: DeFiRank: Federated Pairwise Ranking for Governance in Decentralized Financial Networks
result.summary: Existing governance approaches in decentralized financial networks rely on manual review processes conducted by human committees, which introduces subjective bias, creates a scalability bottleneck under high network volume, and fails to capture complex behavioural patterns and evolving network dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose \name, a federated learning-based pairwise ranking framework in which multiple institutions collaboratively train a ranking model without sharing their private transaction data. This collaborative learning enables the model to capture network-wide behavioural patterns that signify strong network participation and directly contribute to the network effect, including diversity of counterparties, usage of multiple applications, and frequency of transactions. The proposed system ranks providers based on the authenticity of their actions, promoting genuine contributors and demoting those exhibiting suspicious behaviour. We evaluate \name\ on a real-world blockchain transaction dataset. Results demonstrate that the federated approach achieves ranking performance modestly below the centralized baseline (NDCG@15: $\approx$0.87 vs.\ $\approx$0.92) while preserving data privacy and matching its ranking stability (Kendall $τ$: $\approx$0.70 for both regimes), producing reliable governance decisions, including provider promotion and demotion (648 and 39 unique providers, respectively), without requiring centralized access to sensitive transaction data.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DeFiRank，用联邦学习让多家机构在不共享私有交易数据的前提下协同训练 pairwise 排序模型，用于去中心化金融网络的治理评分与参与者升降级，并在真实区块链交易数据上验证排序性能与稳定性。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究内容是区块链治理中的联邦排序与隐私保护，既不涉及多模态/视觉推理，也没有内部推理状态生成、证据获取或停止决策等线索，与研究主线缺少实质联系。
